title: Sniper: Deadliest Missions
description: One of military warfare's specialized jobs involves highly accurate shooting, and skilled snipers talk publicly about their classified missions for the first time.

title: Extreme Marksmen
description: People perform seemingly impossible feats of marksmanship with weapons ranging from crossbows to firearms; Old West mirror-shot challenge; U.S. Army snipers hit targets a mile away.

title: More Extreme Marksmen
description: Experts demonstrate the use of knives, a longbow, a bullwhip, pistols, rifles and shotguns in an exploration of the evolution of weaponry and the history or legends behind marksmanship challenges.

title: Dark Marvels
description:
S01 E01 — Death Devices
Exploring the dark origin stories behind some of history's most notorious methods of execution, from the guillotine to the electric chair.

title: Dark Marvels
description:
S01 E03 — Treacherous Traps
Whether they're used to stop treasure hunters, body snatchers, or wartime enemies, booby traps are diabolical devices just waiting to kill.

title: Dark Marvels
description:
S01 E05 — Blades of Fury
From the destructive Viking axe to the sacred but deadly Samurai katana, checking out razor sharp blades wielded by fearsome warriors that have spilled blood and forged empires.

title: Dark Marvels
description:
S01 E04 — Pain and Punishment
The twisted origin stories of some of history's most diabolically creative and brutal torture devices, from the "Iron Maiden" to the pear of anguish.

title: Dark Marvels
description:
S01 E06 — Superweapons of Fear
From the world's largest trebuchet to Nazi super cannons, these are the deadly weapons that rain destruction and spread fear on the battlefield.

title: Dark Marvels
description:
S01 E02 — Temples of Doom
The gates are open to some of history's sinister structures; from the terrifying Tower of London to a hotel of horrors, discovering the dark secrets hidden within these foreboding fortresses.

title: Dark Marvels
description:
S01 E07 — Sinister Spy Weapons
Exploring the dark art of spy-craft, from the Frankenkitty to the umbrella gun; revealing the deadliest spy weapons deployed to gather information and assassinate enemies.
